description: Wait for the project's production approver to decide a request that came back with status approval_required. Holds up to wait_seconds, then returns state: pending (call again with the same approval_id), executed (approved and run exactly as sent; result is the response the original call would have had, continue), failed (approved but the request did not succeed), denied or expired (refused: it did not run, do not retry it). Never send the original call again while one is pending. wait_seconds: 0 just reads the state. Scope: projects:read.

approval_id.description: The apr_… id from the approval_required reply

organization_id.description: Organization id, e.g. `acme`. Default: the token's.

project_id.description: Project id, e.g. `todo-app`. Default: the last one used, or your only one.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to hold for a decision (default 45; 0 returns at once)

name: approvals_wait
title: Wait for a production approval
